claims: The Founder (2016) is a biographical drama.
Michael Keaton as Ray Kroc in The Founder.
Nick Offerman as Richard "Dick" McDonald in The Founder.
John Carroll Lynch as Maurice "Mac" McDonald in The Founder.
Linda Cardellini as Joan Smith in The Founder.
B.J. Novak as Harry J. Sonneborn in The Founder.
Ray Kroc was a struggling milkshake machine salesman.
Ray Kroc visited a small drive-in in San Bernardino, California.
The drive-in was run by Dick and Mac McDonald.
Dick and Mac McDonald pioneered the "Speedee Service System".
The "Speedee Service System" reduced service time from 30 minutes to 30 seconds.
The "Speedee Service System" focused on a limited menu of burgers, fries, sodas.
Ray Kroc convinced the McDonald brothers to franchise.
The franchising contract gave Ray Kroc limited control.
The contract created friction over quality control and changes.
Harry Sonneborn advised Ray Kroc.
Ray Kroc pivoted to purchasing the land for new restaurants.
Ray Kroc created Franchise Realty Corporation.
Franchise Realty Corporation leveraged financial control over the McDonald brothers.
Ray Kroc broke ties with the McDonald brothers.
Ray Kroc purchased the company for $2.7 million.
Ray Kroc forced the McDonald brothers to remove their names from the original restaurant.
Ray Kroc put the original restaurant out of business.
The Founder is set in the 1950s.
The film received generally positive reviews for its performances and direction.
